doctors.bio: Dr. Ramakanth is the dentist behind Sri Parvathi Dental Clinic at Pathur Road Cross, Tadepalle. He holds an MDS — a postgraduate master's degree in dental surgery taken after the five-year BDS. Patients reviewing the clinic on Google most often mention his patience, the clinic's helpful staff and modern equipment, and treatments such as root canals and wisdom tooth removal. At your first visit he examines your teeth and gums, explains what he finds and talks you through your options before any treatment starts.

_note_doctorsNotInImporter: The importer does not set appointmentDurationMinutes or weekly schedules. Apply afterwards via the admin API: PUT /clinics/{id}/doctors/{doctorId} {appointmentDurationMinutes: 20}, then POST /clinics/{id}/doctors/{doctorId}/schedules per day (Monday–Saturday, 9:30 AM – 9:30 PM; Sunday, 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM). No photos: initials avatars.
_note_testimonials: None by policy: never invent or copy reviews. Google review requests can be switched on (Enterprise) once the review link is set.

faqs.question: What are the clinic's timings?
faqs.answer: We are open Monday–Saturday, 9:30 AM – 9:30 PM; Sunday, 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM. Timings can change on festival days, so please call ahead on a holiday.

faqs.question: Where exactly is the clinic?
faqs.answer: On the first floor of Perreddy Complex at Pathur Road Cross, Tadepalle, near Reliance Digital — First Floor, Perreddy Complex, Pathur Road Cross, near Reliance Digital, Tadepalle, Tadepalli, Andhra Pradesh 522501.

faqs.question: Do I need an appointment?
faqs.answer: Booking online or by phone means you are seen at a fixed time with little waiting. If you walk in, we will fit you in as soon as we can.

faqs.question: How much will my treatment cost?
faqs.answer: It depends on what the examination shows. Dr. Ramakanth explains the plan and its cost before any treatment begins, so there are no surprises.

faqs.question: Is the first visit just a consultation?
faqs.answer: Usually, yes: a careful examination, a chat about what we found and your options. Simple treatment can sometimes be done the same day if you wish.

faqs.question: Do you see children?
faqs.answer: Yes. We keep early visits short and friendly, and give parents practical advice on brushing and diet.
